text:
ash: Quick proposal — move our weekly triage to Wednesdays at 09:30 PT starting next week. Better for RFC syncs and gives post-release buffer.
carla: Works for me. Wednesday mornings are clear. :+1:
sam: 09:30 PT ok, but can we lock it at 45m? last time we drifted and folks left early.
lee: 45m sounds good. Suggested agenda: 10m bug queue, 20m backlog/owner assignments, 10m RFC/design quick checks, 5m roll call/blockers.
ton y: happy to run facilitator rotation — I can take the first two weeks.
maria: timezone note: 09:30 PT = 17:30 CET. that's still doable for me but prefer no later than 18:00 CET.
ash: ack on timezone. Tony, can you cover Apr 2 & 9? Carla can follow after that?
tony: yep i can do Apr 2 & 9. small nit: that's tony :)
carla: I'll take the rotation after Tony. One ask: can we add an "Owner" column to the backlog board so we can assign quickly during triage?
sam: also propose a mini-ticket template we paste when we assign during the call, something like:
```
- ID: 
- Owner: 
- Priority: P1/P2/P3
- Action: assign/fix/monitor
- ETA: 
```
lee: if triage-bot can insert that as a checklist automatically when we tag a ticket during the meeting it'd save minutes.
triage-bot: feature: /triage template apply ISSUE-456 — inserts the standard checklist into the issue (dev preview).
ash: calendar invite updated to Wed 09:30 PT recurring weekly: https://calendar.company.com/teams/eng/triage — please RSVP.
maria: RSVP'd. Can we keep the first 10m strictly for high-sev bugs so we don't run over?
carla: +1 to those timeboxes. Also let's try to only put tickets on the agenda that have an assigned owner or a clear ask.
sam: i'll pin the bug queue filter and the triage checklist doc in the channel before the meeting.
ash: PRs/Code review note: please assign an owner before the meeting if you want it discussed. otherwise we'll skip unassigned PRs to stay on schedule.
tony: I'll post a reminder in #eng the morning of the meeting with the facilitator and agenda. Will tag any owners for items on the list.
maria: can we trial a small digest that emails assignees after the meeting with action items? low friction automation would help.
lee: i'll measure attendance/coverage for two weeks to see if 45m keeps participation high. report back after two meetings.
ash: if there are no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll finalize the invite and add a facilitator rotation table in the pinned agenda doc.
carla: no objections here. :ok_hand: 
sam: good with it.
triage-bot: invite updated; next meeting ts=1746004856 (Wed) — reminders set for 15m and 5m before.
ash: closing — final agenda + pinned links in the doc. Reopen thread if anything urgent comes up before EOD.
